t: 德胜谢克帕 第5任噶尔玛帕喇嘛出访南京明朝首都并被授予"达摩大宝亲王"称号.
te: Deshin Shekpa, 5th Karmapa Lama visits the Ming dynasty capital at Nanjing and is awarded the title "Great Treasure Pri…
dz: 德胜谢克帕 第5任噶尔玛帕喇嘛出访南京明朝首都并被授予"达摩大宝亲王"称号.
de: Deshin Shekpa, 5th Karmapa Lama visits the Ming dynasty capital at Nanjing and is awarded the title "Great Treasure Prince of Dharma".

t: 胡朝退位国王胡贵黎和他的儿子胡汉上王被明军俘虏。
te: Retired King Hồ Quý Ly and his son King Hồ Hán Thương of Hồ dynasty are captured by the Ming armies.
dz: 明胡战争：胡朝退位国王胡贵黎和他的儿子胡汉上王被明军俘虏。
de: Ming–Hồ War: Retired King Hồ Quý Ly and his son King Hồ Hán Thương of Hồ dynasty are captured by the Ming armies.

t: Ulrich von Jungingen成为铁道骑士团的外公.
te: Ulrich von Jungingen becomes Grand Master of the Teutonic Knights.
dz: Ulrich von Jungingen成为铁道骑士团的外公.
de: Ulrich von Jungingen becomes Grand Master of the Teutonic Knights.

t: 无所畏惧的约翰·勃艮第公爵和奥尔良公爵瓦卢瓦的路易同意停战,但三天后勃艮第将杀死奥尔良.

dz: 无所畏惧的约翰·勃艮第公爵和奥尔良公爵瓦卢瓦的路易同意停战,但三天后勃艮第将杀死奥尔良.
de: John the Fearless, Duke of Burgundy, and Louis of Valois, Duke of Orléans, agree to a truce, but Burgundy would kill Orléans three days later.
